_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a global biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases.' (FY2011 10-K, Item 7); 'We face intense competition from other pharmaceutical manufacturers, including for both innovative medicines and lower-priced generic products.' (Item 1A heading); 'We depend on certain key products for most of our net sales, cash flows and earnings and U.S. market exclusivity for PLAVIX* and AVAPRO*/AVALIDE* in the U.S. is expected to expire in May 2012 and March 2012, respectively.' (Item 1A heading); 'It is possible that we may lose market exclusivity of a product earlier than expected.' (Item 1A heading)

(Item 1A heading). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.57x; +13% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.25; conservative 2yr +2%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -65.2%/yr (worst year FY02-FY11, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-15.3%/yr (FY12 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +8.2%/yr (FY02-FY11 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +83.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY11); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2012-07-13) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.57x (91.5% downside to Bear $3 / +58.3% upside to Bull $56) | Adj composite 2.46 vs market 2.21: gap +0.25 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +13% above the EPP floor $31 (16x FY12E $1.95) | Conservative 2-yr case: +1.6% total (+0.8%/yr) | At 18.1x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $47 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; U.S. revenues +6.2% in Q1 2012, forward revenues -19% to -14.3% (FY12 sales guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
